scrap-shove.goal: Make every robot crash before one catches you.
scrap-shove.how-to-play.step-1: Tap a square next to you to step there.
scrap-shove.how-to-play.step-2: Walk into scrap to shove it.
scrap-shove.how-to-play.step-3: After your move, every robot steps toward you.
scrap-shove.how-to-play.step-4: Make robots crash into each other or into scrap.
scrap-shove.name: Scrap Shove
scrap-shove.tagline: Outsmart the robots. Make them crash.
scrap-shove.tutorial.step-1: Tap a square next to you to move.
scrap-shove.tutorial.step-2: Each robot just took one step toward you.
scrap-shove.tutorial.step-3: Step aside and let two robots crash!
scrap-shove.tutorial.step-4: Walk into scrap to shove it at a robot.
